name: Miku Vinchester
source:
Miku has a very dark past that is not easy to talk about. Now she is trying to make amends for her mistakes. The first thing she did was banish [url=https://vndb.org/c144571]Lucifer[/url] from [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]me[/url]. Her attitude towards other girls is terrible. I hope that this time she will be able to live with them in love and harmony.

[In game description]
